# GeekFlux

> An independent magazine covering studying, reading, habits, technology, and culture — written to help people learn, focus, and stick with what matters.

GeekFlux also surfaces practical iOS tools for spaced-repetition revision (Revu), focus-first reading (ReadFast), and habit streaks (Streakly).

## Guides (start here)

- [Studying & Memory](https://geekflux.in/studying-and-memory/): Spaced repetition, revision planning, and durable learning systems
- [Reading & Focus](https://geekflux.in/reading-and-focus/): Speed, attention, PDFs, and finishing what you start
- [Habits & Routines](https://geekflux.in/habits-and-routines/): Building habits, streak psychology, and realistic mornings
